'''Tanith Sorn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Tanith Sorn worked as a bridge [[Officer/Legends|officer]] aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], where she developed a rivalry with her fellow bridge officer Lieutenant [[Ein Truminn]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], around the time of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Sorn began to suspect that [[Malkor Trel]], a crewman aboard the ship, was a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Sorn's suspicions were correct and Trel decided to silence her to prevent his cover from being blown, by programming some of the ships [[ASP-7 labor droid/Legends|ASP-7 labor droids]] to [[Death/Legends|murder]] her. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] killed Sorn and afterwards, a group of ''Executor'' crewmen, including [[Suba (lieutenant)/Legends|Suba]], were chosen by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to investigate her death.
